svg.text: EchoVault (v3) — HPKE End-to-End Channel · Alice (Browser) ⇄ Bob (Echo Server) · inside TLS 1.3
Each numbered action of RFC 9180 HPKE (hpke-js ⇄ pyhpke) — from BIP-39 identity through Chat-UI prompt, sealed transmission, and echo back.
Suite: DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA-256) · KDF: HKDF-SHA-256 · AEAD: ChaCha20-Poly1305
Identity from BIP-39 (done once, offline, key material never leaves the endpoint)
ALICE · derive identity in the browser
Authenticated handshake (only PUBLIC keys cross the wire, Ed25519-signed; server key pinned)
Alice PINS Bob’s keys from GET /pubkey · both verify Ed25519 sigs · swapped key ⇒ sig fails (T11 / P8)
💬 Chat UI · user types a prompt
m = “Summarize patient note #4471 for Dr. Lee…”
HPKE Seal (Alice → Bob) — turn plaintext into { enc, ct }
1 Encap: gen ephemeral (skE, pkE); enc = pkE
Transmit client→server (sealed envelope rides inside the TLS tunnel)
outer TLS 1.3 (wss://) — terminates at the proxy
attacker sees only { enc, ct } = ▓▓▓ ciphertext · no skB ⇒ cannot open
BOB · HPKE.Open(enc, skB_x25519, info, aad, ct)
1 Decap: DH = X25519(skB_x25519, enc) → same secret
Echo + HPKE Seal (Bob → Alice) — seal the reply to Alice’s key
2 Encap to pkA_x25519: ephemeral (skE', pkE'); enc'=pkE'
Transmit server→client (sealed reply, again inside TLS)
outer TLS 1.3 (wss://) — terminates at the proxy
attacker still sees only { enc', ct' } = ▓▓▓ ciphertext
HPKE Open + render (Alice) — close the loop in the Chat UI
ALICE · HPKE.Open(enc', skA_x25519, info', aad', ct')
1 Decap: DH' = X25519(skA_x25519, enc') → same secret
“ECHO: Summarize patient note #4471 for Dr. Lee…”
Outer TLS protects transport + metadata but terminates at the proxy. The inner HPKE seal protects the payload END-TO-END — only the holder of the
recipient X25519 key can Open it. The handshake is Ed25519-authenticated against a PINNED key, so a swapped /pubkey key is rejected (T11 / P8).
Caveat: Alice’s recipient key is her STATIC BIP-39 key ⇒ the s2c direction has no forward secrecy (→ Morphex epoch-ratchet stretch). Open gap: served-JS.
